# Heinrich Aldegrever ornament prints

Foliate panels, candelabrum grotesques, masks, satyrs, children and a dagger sheath engraved by Heinrich Aldegrever in Soest, about 1525–1555, from twenty sheets in Cleveland, New York, Hamburg and Washington; loose prints by one artist, grouped by sheet.

Part of [Ducktape Assets](https://github.com/adrian729/ducktape-assets). Set id `aldegrever-prints`, historical, 22 assets, version 1.0.0.

## Licence and attribution

Artwork: **LicenseRef-PDM** ([text](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/)). The Hamburg sheets carry the Public Domain Mark; the Cleveland, Metropolitan and Washington sheets are CC0 and say so on the asset. See SOURCES.md.

Author: adrian729. Maintainer: https://github.com/adrian729/ducktape-assets/issues. See [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md) and [SOURCES.md](SOURCES.md).
